_comment: Per-repo audit overrides. Copy to <report-folder>/audit-config/<repo-name>.json and fill it in. The guardrail consumes these at triage time; the sensors still report everything, the config only changes how a finding is classified.

secretAllowlist._comment: If the secret scanner flags a key that is FAKE on purpose (a dummy key inside a test/example file), list it here so the report stops calling it a real leak. Only fill it when a scan flags a deliberate fake.

documentedExperimentBranches._comment: If the repo has extra branches that are a deliberate experiment worth keeping, list them here. Then the audit says 'add a README note pointing at this branch' instead of 'delete this stale branch'.

waivers._comment: Human-approved waivers of findings that would otherwise BLOCK. Only the human writes these. Each needs findingId + reason + date. A waiver is the ONLY way a Critical finding stops blocking publish.

readmeClaimOverrides._comment: Optional: README claims the deterministic check can't resolve but you have manually verified (e.g. a command that exists behind a wrapper). Documents why a flagged claim is actually fine.
